title: ArtCraft: The Free Open-Source AI Film Studio
description:
ArtCraft is a free, open-source AI film studio: instead of typing a prompt and hoping, you build the scene first, like a film set, and only then generate. It picked up over 3,000 GitHub stars in a single day.

How it works
• Its makers call it "the IDE for artists": one desktop app with a 2D canvas for composing and a 3D stage for blocking scenes.
• Drop in a room, place your actors and pose them like mannequins, then put the virtual camera exactly where you want it and frame the shot.
• Turn a picture into a 3D object you can rotate, and kitbash whole sets from asset kits.
• Generate from that blocking: the posed mannequins guide where the characters stand. Keep the same room for every shot, so a whole sequence stays consistent.
• Quick tools too: text-to-image, editing with a mask, and image-to-video.

Models
It plugs into a long list of image, video and 3D models, including Midjourney, Sora 2, Grok Imagine and World Labs' Marble 3D worlds, plus Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 1.5, Seedance 2.0, Kling and more.

Price and platforms
The app is free and open source. Generating isn't: bring your own subscriptions, or buy credits, from $8 a month billed yearly ($96 a year for the Basic plan, 1,000 credits a month). Builds for Windows and Mac; on Linux you build it from source.
